audit.why: 51.4% over 1284 games and EVEN at 6/10 fits a lane you own from level 2 to the first-item timing and lose late to his masterwork scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Skill, Skill, Ornn, Ornn. The packet says Ornn, Illaoi, Illaoi, Illaoi, Illaoi, Skill, Ornn — six of seven rows disagreed.
audit.why: The prose already describes the packet shape: level 1 to Ornn, 'from level 2 through 5 you take over', and the lane re-tilting only as his items complete. whys[4] and whys[5] were the two rows that also had to move to stay consistent with the packet.
audit.corrected: All six wrong rows flipped as matched full+content pairs, ratings on rows 3 and 4 raised from 4/10 to 6/10, and whys[4]/whys[5] rewritten so the explanations match their new sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ornn's W and E were swapped ('his W Searing Charge / Bellows Breath brace'), and two ability names were invented: 'Rising Cinders' for his dash and 'brittle-Flame-Chompers' for his setup.
audit.why: Riot's kit is W = Bellows Breath (advances breathing fire; the final gout applies Brittle, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) and E = Searing Charge (charge that only knocks up when he collides with terrain, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s). There is no 'Rising Cinders'; Flame Chompers belongs to Jinx. The terrain requirement on Searing Charge is the decisive interaction — away from walls he has no engage on you at all.
audit.corrected: Correct names and cooldowns used, and the wall requirement on Searing Charge stated as the positioning rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown advice named Volcanic Rupture as the tracked spell but carried no numbers anywhere.
audit.why: Bellows Breath at 12s rank 1 is the window that decides your slam trade, and Call of the Forge God is 140s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written into spikes[0].text and spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'brace' damage reduction on Bellows Breath is referenced repeatedly but is not in Riot's text in this data.
audit.why: The kit description for Bellows Breath covers only the fire breath and the Brittle application. Per the brief, absent means unknown, so I did not build advice on the brace.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[0].text around Brittle, which Riot's text does state.
